base.sourceNote: Base-game Create-a-Sim options, written from general knowledge of the game (not in the learner's pack files). Learner to sanity-check.

orientation.describe: Who they're romantically attracted to (men, women, or both), who they're interested in WooHoo with (men, women, or both), whether they're exploring romantically, or whether they're not interested in romance at all.

boundaries.describe: Whether they get jealous, and what they'd accept from a partner with other Sims (nothing at all; flirting is fine; open to their partner having other romantic relationships).
